description: The new skipped-search mode leaves verbose reporting without mse_scale.
trigger: Call regularize with skip_g_scale=True and verbose=True, after successful preprocessing.
expected_behavior: Return regularized weights and either omit sample MSE or report it unavailable.
actual_behavior: The unchanged verbose block calls mse_scale.item(), but the new skip branch defines only g_scale, causing an unbound local access.

verification.description: Compared assignment branches with the verbose reader and all located direct callers. The new script supplies verbose=False; quantize_exl3 keeps skip_g_scale=False.
verification.limits: No located repository caller selects the failing combination; this concerns the newly exposed argument combination.
